The certificate must be uploaded and checked before the first order is placed."
Under POL-SUP-003 §3.5: "A supplier created in Bahi is ACTIVE from the day it is created, but no order may be placed with it until every document in §3.2 and, for food-contact parts, the certificate in §4 is on file."
Under POL-SUP-003 §4.1: "A supplier of any part that comes into contact with food (gaskets, lids, body blanks, and any item marked food-contact in the item master) must hold a food-grade certificate. This is the certificate referred to in Purchase Policy §6.2."
Moreover, Shakti Seals is not an existing supplier in Bahi (confirmed by `find_supplier`). Even if we were to onboard them, Bahi requires the food-grade certificate to be uploaded and verified before any order for food-contact parts can be placed with them.

Shakti Seals does not have a food-grade certificate on file.
